title.narrative: 2024 SS4026 South Sudan Joint Response

description.narrative: 1. Strengthened agency of conflict affected boys, girls, women and people with disabilities to identify, prevent and respond to protection threats (Child Protection, MHPSS, GBV, Sexual Reproductive Health Rights). 2. Improved learners’ access to learning facilities and learning outcomes (literacy and numeracy) through alternative and accelerated teaching and learning methodologies. 3. Strengthened socio-economic resilience of crises-affected populations (affected conflict/displacement, climate change, economic, and GBV), including youth at risk of recruitment into armed forces and armed groups
